name: The Hollow 01 · Rave spectrum
status: Imported into hosted Playlist Lab for review; Spotify candidate order verified. Not a host-approved party sequence.
selection_method: 50 tracks, ten each in Techno, Tech house, Drum & bass, Acid and Trance, interleaved for fast calibration. Fifty distinct lead selection groups; max two tracks per credited artist; no album blocks. Editorial lanes are curation hypotheses, not Spotify genre measurements. No intro/interlude/outro track titles; DJ intros and breakdowns still require listening.
brief: High energy, bouncy, dark underground rave vibes, with established producers/DJs and broad artist variety. Pop-facing/bright and long-form boundary probes carry explicit per-track risks.

catalog_verification.note: Playability is a catalog result, not an audio audition, permission to download, or a device playback test.
catalog_verification.replacement_note: Bedroom rank32 changed before publication to avoid the Chris Lake recording independently selected for living-room Batch06; the replacement is new to both rooms by URI and ISRC.

metrics.runtime_note: Review sample only. Arithmetic joins are not measured mixing. A final approved playable programme still needs nine hours after real cuts/transitions.
